title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 Orbit is an SF\\-based AI startup. An AI college admissions counselor helping high school students get into their dream college with ease and access.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 You'd be our senior full\\-stack engineer, working directly with the founders on a codebase you'll shape rather than inherit. This is a small team, so the scope is wide: you'll own features end to end, from schema design through the API layer to what the student sees.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Agentic execution. We’re building Cowork — the layer that moves Orbit from giving advice to doing the work. Finding relevant research labs and drafting the outreach, chasing recommendation letters, tracking deadlines across a dozen portals. This is event\\-sourced agent infrastructure with real reliability requirements, because the failure mode isn't a bad answer, it's a missed deadline a student can't get back.
* AI systems that have to be right. Solvi runs on frontier LLMs, but the value is in the layer we own: retrieval over student context, prompt and orchestration architecture, and the evaluation harness that tells us whether a change made things better. If you've built LLM systems past the demo stage and know how much of the work is in the evals, you'll recognize this problem.



  





  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* 3\\+ years building and shipping production software, with real ownership of what you built
* Strong TypeScript/React and Python — our stack is Next.js on Vercel, FastAPI services, and Postgres on Supabase
* Comfort designing relational schemas and reasoning about query performance, not just consuming an ORM
* Experience building on LLM APIs in production, including the unglamorous parts: evals, cost, latency, and failure handling
* Judgment about when to build the durable version and when to ship the version that answers the question this week



  





  





**Required Skills** 




  





  




* Nice to have: browser automation, third\\-party integration work (SFTP, CRMs, OAuth), Azure, or prior time at a seed\\-stage company.
* What matters more than any of the above: that you can operate without a spec. We don't have a product org handing you tickets. The problems arrive as "students are dropping off during onboarding" and you're expected to have opinions about why.



  





  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





  





 Compensation: 12 lakhs LPA plus .5\\-1% equity. We’re pre\\-seed, so this is a genuine trade — below\\-market cash for meaningful ownership. We’ll be direct about the numbers in the first conversation rather than making you ask.
 



  





  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





  





 We are committed to diversity and inclusivity.
 



  





  





**Why this might not be for you** 




  





  





 We’re pre\\-seed. The runway is finite, the roadmap changes, and some of what you build will be thrown away. We have real technical debt — a partial cloud migration and schema carryover from an earlier platform — and you’d be helping fix it, not arriving to something pristine.
 



  





  





 If you want a defined lane and a mature codebase, this isn’t it. If you want to be the engineer who shapes what this becomes, it might be.
 



  





  





**To apply** 




  





  





 Apply on Linkedin. Preferred: Email contact@findmyorbit.com with something you’ve built that you’re proud of and a sentence on why this problem interests you. No cover letter necessary.

title: Architecture Verification Engineer
description:
We are looking for a flexible, inquisitive engineer with an interest in compilers, language runtimes, and CPU architecture. In this role, you will study existing, new and proposed extensions to the Arm architecture to determine their applicability and optimal use by a variety of modern language runtimes and compilers. You will work with Arm architects to help shape future architecture features, and with runtime engineers to ensure they are used effectively in real\\-world language implementations. The technologies covered include Java, JavaScript, Python, Rust, WebAssembly and more.
   

  

 You'll be part of the bigger CE\\-SW Runtimes team, whose goal is to improve modern languages support on the Arm architecture, from JavaScript to Rust. You will work closely with the team and colleagues across the organisation and with open\\-source communities to tackle challenges in enabling the future of computing.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyse architecture features and find opportunities for their use in language runtimes and compilers.
* Work with architects to suggest or improve proposals, as appropriate.
* Own and be accountable for specific investigations, with guidance where appropriate.
* Collaborate with colleagues across Arm to improve the Arm architecture, and to ensure it is effectively used.
* Contribute to open\\-source software projects and engage with open\\-source communities.
* Contribute to documentation efforts (including internal documentation and external blog posts) to communicate findings.
* Help develop tooling and automation to support the above activities.


**Required skills and experience**
* A flexible, problem\\-solving approach, and a commitment to extend the breadth and depth of knowledge.
* Experience working on language runtimes, compilers or similar technologies.
* Strong programming skills in at least one of C, C\\+\\+ or Rust.
* Familiarity with concepts of computer architecture and microarchitecture, such as cache hierarchies and CPU pipelines, preferably relating to AArch64\\.


**Nice\\-to\\-have skills and experience**
* Proficiency in one or more of Java, JavaScript, Python, Rust or WebAssembly.
* Familiarity with assembly language and low\\-level development for AArch64\\.
* Familiarity with Linux performance analysis tools and system\\-level performance tuning.
* Familiarity with build systems and CI.
* Experience contributing to open\\-source projects.


**In return**
 You will have the opportunity to learn about and influence the latest Arm architecture features, working closely with highly skilled engineering teams on ground\\-breaking technology. You will collaborate with diverse compiler and runtime teams and open\\-source communities, contributing to language implementations used by millions of developers worldwide. You will be empowered to continually identify and roll out improvements to our ways of working.
   

  

 If skilled worker sponsorship is required, Arm will meet costs associated with sponsorship for the employer only. All fees associated with the individual’s application e.g. visa application fee and Immigration Health Surcharge, will be the responsibility of the successful candidate.
   

  

****Our 10x Mindset****
 At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https://careers.arm.com/10x\\-mindset
   

  

****Use of AI in Your Application****
 At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application, and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI\\-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm.com so we can support you.
   

  

****Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations****
 At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm.com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed to the extent necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process.
   

  

****Hybrid Working****
 Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you.
   

  

****Equal Opportunities****
